memory.scope: Warm full solves; allocation hooks count active CuPy device-pool bytes and check final accounting. Excludes allocations outside the CuPy pool, desktop and driver contexts. Coordinate H counts include CG and its true residual, excluding physical Afun audits, RHS and cold tuning. Hooked wall times are not performance results.

cpu_spectrum.scope: Independent CPU64 dense fine spectrum, all mean-free real modes of odd 5^3. Local Q1 auxiliary, not a hardware timing. Six CG RHS use coordinate rtol 1e-8 for this spectral check only.
